videos.script:
The links service has had a secret in its code since lesson six. {{secret}} The admin key, in a file, in every copy of the repository. Today it leaves, and so does every other value that changes between your laptop and a server.

{{env}} It starts with the environment. A list of names and values every process inherits, all of them strings. A .env file for your laptop, and the rule that the real environment always wins over it.

{{config}} Then one module that reads it all, once. It turns strings into the types the code needs, and refuses to start if anything is missing, with every problem listed. A service that fails at start-up fails where somebody is watching.

{{key}} Then the secret itself. Generated, never typed. Ignored by git before the file exists. And never printed, even in the line the server writes when it starts.

{{tests}} And the tests get an environment of their own, so they stop writing their links into yours.
